name: Sure Guernsey Data Centre
notes: Sure's official business pages describe a Tier III Guernsey data centre with colocation, remote hands, inter-island connectivity, dual power feeds and resilient on-site generation; the Guernsey facility page states 2MW IT load.

name: JT First Tower Lane Data Centre
notes: JT's official data-centres page says its primary data centre sites in Jersey and Guernsey are ISO/IEC 27001, PCI-DSS and SOC2 certified. JT's First Tower Lane facility product description identifies the Guernsey facility; 2014 local press also names First Tower Lane as JT's Guernsey data centre.

name: JT St Georges Hall Data Centre
notes: DataCenterMap lists JT St Georges Hall, St Georges Esplanade, St Peter Port as a JT-owned Tier 1 Guernsey data centre. JT's official site independently confirms Guernsey data-centre operations, but the St Georges Hall facility detail is from an aggregate directory.

name: States of Guernsey / Agilisys JT-hosted Data Centre
notes: Trade press reported two new States of Guernsey data centres delivered in 2020 to replace ageing IT infrastructure; one was located in a JT Guernsey hosting facility. A States review PDF later confirms Agilisys provisioned two new data centres for States IT services.

name: States of Guernsey / Agilisys Logicalis-hosted Data Centre
notes: Trade press reported the second of two new States of Guernsey data centres was located in a Logicalis Guernsey hosting facility, designed as a resilient and sustainable platform for States services for at least 10 years. A States review PDF confirms the two-data-centre provisioning by Agilisys.
